newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Eletrobras H1 profit higher.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Eletrobras H1 profit higher.

text.p: Brazil state power utility holding Eletrobras issued the following statement on its 1996 first half results.
NOTE: All figures in Brazilian reais.
Share profit figures provided in lots of 1,000 shares.

In a statement, Eletrobras said its results reflected the de-ndexation of its balance sheet. It also said the company's investments were adjusted by IGPM inflation index while assets had no accounting correction.
The statement also highlighted the firm's bank debt of which 95 percent is in foreign currency and which increased close to 3.28 percent in the first half.
Its domestic debt was indexed to the IGPM inflation index and increased 6.15 percent in the period, it added.
Eletrobras total assets reached 86 billion reais and its net worth was 70 billion reais, it said.
